is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west), Vgsc L995S (kdr-east), and Ace-1 G119S (page 5, 9, 11, 12).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 2, 3, and 4 provide genotype counts (SS, SR, RR) and allelic frequencies for the markers across multiple sentinel districts (page 11, 12).

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses wild adult female Anopheles gambiae s.l. collected from 22 sentinel districts in Tanzania (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data collected in 2023 (page 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study reports data for 22 specific sentinel districts in Tanzania (page 3, 6, 7).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between May and July 2023 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new country-wide survey conducted in 2023.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study conducted a country-wide insecticide resistance monitoring survey in Tanzania in 2023 across 22 sentinel districts. It assessed phenotypic resistance to pyrethroids and pirimiphos-methyl, the impact of PBO synergists, and the frequency of kdr (L995F/S) and Ace-1 (G119S) mutations in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations.
